name: image_to_3d_pixal3d
description: Pixal3D image-to-3D: turns a single reference image into a textured GLB mesh with PBR maps (base colour, metallic, roughness, ambient occlusion, normal). Shares the TRELLIS.2 sampling stages, shape/texture VAEs and DINOv3 encoder, but conditions on projection-aware features: MoGe-2 estimates the photo's field of view and Pixal3DConditioning back-projects high-resolution DINOv3 features onto the voxel grid, so the mesh tracks the input's perspective more closely. Pipeline: BiRefNet background removal, square composite via ImageCropToMask (pad_factor 1.1, as Pixal3D expects), structure/shape/upsample/texture sampling, then remesh -> decimate -> UV unwrap -> texture bake. Output is a single .glb retrieved with get_image. No text prompt — geometry and texture come entirely from the input image.

image.description: Reference image to reconstruct in 3D. A single, centred subject on a plain background works best; the background is removed automatically. The visible side drives the geometry — unseen faces are hallucinated.

shape_resolution.description: Voxel resolution of the upsampled shape stage. Integer 1024-2048 in steps of 128; default 1536. Higher means finer geometric detail and more VRAM.

texture_resolution.description: Baked texture map size in pixels (default 4096). Feeds both the UV unwrap and the texture bake. Drop to 2048 to halve bake time and file size.

face_count.description: Target triangle count after decimation (default 700000). Lower it (e.g. 100000) for a game-ready or web-ready asset.
